agents.name: showrunner
agents.description: Owns the overall production: story vision, phase sequencing, and cross-department arbitration.

agents.name: screenwriter
agents.description: Writes and revises the screenplay, treatment, and story bible in proper screenplay format.

agents.name: script-editor
agents.description: Analyzes and critiques scripts for structure, pacing, dialogue, and narrative continuity.

agents.name: visual-director
agents.description: Defines and guards the project's visual language: style bible, palettes, and look consistency.

agents.name: character-designer
agents.description: Designs characters and wardrobe, maintaining identity consistency across every asset.

agents.name: production-designer
agents.description: Designs locations and props, including spatial maps and set dressing continuity.

agents.name: storyboard-artist
agents.description: Translates shot lists into storyboard frames with composition and staging notes.

agents.name: cinematographer
agents.description: Chooses lensing, camera movement, coverage, and lighting strategy for every scene.

agents.name: shot-planner
agents.description: Breaks scenes into ordered, schema-valid shots with axes, blocking, and clip boundaries.

agents.name: continuity-supervisor
agents.description: Tracks axes, screen direction, wardrobe, and prop state; flags continuity violations.

agents.name: prompt-director
agents.description: Selects references and compiles provider-ready prompt packages from bibles and shots.

agents.name: image-generation-specialist
agents.description: Runs image providers to produce keyframes and reference assets with provenance records.

agents.name: video-generation-specialist
agents.description: Runs video providers to produce clips from prompt packages, keyframes, and references.

agents.name: editor
agents.description: Assembles the edit plan: clip order, transitions, pacing, and timeline notes.

agents.name: sound-designer
agents.description: Plans dialogue, music, and sound effects, including audio generation briefs.

agents.name: colorist
agents.description: Defines color pipeline and grade intent; keeps looks consistent across shots.

agents.name: production-qa
agents.description: Validates artifacts against schemas and rules; gates approvals and audits provenance.
